attchmntText: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Corrigendum to the Press Release-Financial Performance for the Quarter and Half Year endedSeptember 30, 2026 dated November 10, 2026".
Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification regarding Non-Publication of Newspaper Advertisement under Regulation 47 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015'.
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited clarifies that the newspaper advertisement for financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, was not published in the Pune and Ahmedabad editions of Business Standard. The company submitted content and instructions to the newspaper agency on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, within the prescribed timeline. The delay in Pune and Ahmedabad was due to a public holiday in those regions, which prevented publication on the scheduled date. The company states this was beyond its control. The advertisement was published in all other states within the stipulated timeline. Business Standard confirmed no issues were released in some editions due to Diwali and Bhai Duj, with specific publication dates listed for various cities. Suraksha Diagnostic requests this clarification be taken on record.

attchmntText: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Corrigendum to the Press Release -Interview published in The Times of India dated November11, 2026, regarding Financial Performance for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.'.
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited issued a corrigendum to a press release interview published in The Times of India on November 11, 2026. The correction addresses inadvertent errors in the financial performance report for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The headline is corrected from net profit to total income. The headline now reads Suraksha Diag sees over 100 Crore total income in Q2. The quarter on quarter net profit figure is corrected from 100.5 Crore to 15 Crore for Q2 FY 2026-27. The company states these changes clarify actual financial performance. The notice is signed by Shreya Arora, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited published its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 10, 2026. The company disclosed this publication in newspapers Business Standard and Aajkaal on November 11, 2026. The results are available on the company website www.surakshanet.com. The document also contains notices from Punjab National Bank and IDBI Bank Limited regarding the enforcement of security interests under the SARFAESI Act, 2002. These notices relate to the sale of immovable properties to recover dues from defaulting borrowers. The IDBI Bank e-auction for specific properties is scheduled for December 15, 2026.

attchmntText: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Press release in respect of Unaudited (Standalone and Consolidated) Financial Results of theCompany for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited disclosed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income for the half year was 1893.09 million, up 24 percent year on year. EBITDA stood at 678.47 million, a 37 percent increase. Profit after tax reached 277.96 million, reflecting a 54 percent growth. Earnings per share were 5.38. For the second quarter, profit after tax grew 69 percent to 149.50 million. EBITDA rose 45 percent to 363.17 million. The company opened five new diagnostic centres. Suraksha Genomics continues to build its presence. The announcement was made on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: Outcome of Board Meeting held today i.e. 10th November 2026
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results, both Standalone and Consolidated, for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors held this meeting on Tuesday, 10th November, 2026. The session commenced at 03:00 P.M. IST and concluded at 03:40 P.M. IST. The financial results are enclosed with the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors. These results are also available on the Company’s website at www.surakshanet.com. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III and Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015. The Company’s CIN is L85110WB2005PLC102265. The registered office is located at 12/1, Premises No. 02-0327, DG Block, Action Area 1D, New Town, Kolkata-700 156, West Bengal, India. The Company Secretary and Compliance Officer is Shreya Arora, with Membership Number 30892.
